basic_info.headline: High-impact technical leader, software engineer, and root-cause analyst. Currently prioritizing remote/hybrid work.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer, DEVX
experience.description:
Develop a bespoke metrics gathering and presentation capability based on Matomo, an extensive, object-oriented PHP-based web analytics platform. Support integration of customer applications into tracking framework. Enable exploration of application usage across organizations, over custom timeframes. Iterate as newly-enabled customer insights drive further requirements. Supply leadership with monthly, semi-automated usage reports during development and integration.

• To support customer requirements, implemented a Matomo plugin that queries, merges, and transposes DataTables for multiple sites at once, and enables their proper rendering for display, export, and analytics.
• Assumed ownership of an Excel-strangling, bug-ridden metrics spreadsheet with a copy-paste workflow. Replaced it with a Python script to ingest disparate logs and data exports and correlate user activity across numerous applications, then generate a spreadsheet enriched with user information.
• Developed relationships with key stakeholders and providers across the organization. Drove changes to retention and reporting policies, and collaborated on metrics requirements.
• Wrote a module to enrich logged visits with user information in real time by querying the enterprise user directory. Entries are cached for future hits. Developed a custom dashboard to show service usage across organizational lines.
• Automated deployment with CI code that installs the latest version of the plugin and PKI certificates when building the application server. Created a Terraform configuration to automatically provision ECS, RDS, EC2, Lambda, and load balancer assets.

experience.title: Software Engineering Consultant, CODEMONKEY
experience.description:
Update and extend a Python- and React-based command-and-control web application that has gone virtually unmaintained for years. Help manage client expectations as the new team comes up to speed on a new project and domain, and earn trust by delivering on commitments. Advocate to leadership for engineering best practices and promote them among the development team. Coordinate across multiple teams to create a seamless data flow and user experience.

• When significant changes were proposed to the system state flow, ensured that all relevant stakeholders understood the current and prospective workflows by producing state transition diagrams for each, incorporated feedback, and proceeded to use these to guide both development and testing.
• Implemented a PKI-based authentication system that provides graduated access according to an enterprise authorization service. In the process eliminated an Apache Tomcat (along with JDK and log4j) dependency.
• Hashed out a set of REST APIs with teams from interfacing services and implemented new endpoints to replace existing SOAP interfaces.
• Led the creation of ticketing, version control, and release procedures for the current phase of development.
• Improved maintainability by identifying and excising tens of thousands of lines of abandoned and unreachable code while developing features.

experience.title: Software Engineering Consultant, GAP
experience.description:
Assume and maintain ownership of Object Drive, a cloud storage service on the client network. Oversee development and deployment of AAC, the security and policy enforcement service that governs access throughout the platform. Build a unified team of prime and subcontractor personnel, facilitate task coordination and knowledge transfer, and balance resources between projects. Develop proposals for adapting these services to different platforms and modified requirements.

• Migrated Object Drive, a FIPS 140-2-compliant service, from encrypted backing object storage to unencrypted.
• Devised and led development of a procedure that first uses bulk operations to create a database-migrated, plaintext clone of the Object Drive stack, then keeps them synchronized by keeping a log of mutations from the source stack and submitting them through the API of the destination stack. Operations can then be cut over instantaneously and completely transparently to the user.
• Created a validator for the Object Drive migration which ultimately uncovered years-old bugs in the original Object Drive database migration code (unrelated to the decryption project). Isolated and fixed them.
• Wrote maintenance scripts to make the legacy Object Drive’s frequent outages a thing of the past.
• Identified synergies between file-hosting services and our planned GAP architecture and determined that next-generation file-hosting could be implemented as a browser application interfacing directly with the new platform’s API.

experience.title: Principal Software Engineer, ADV
experience.description:
Contribute to the development of ADV, the Agency's suite of web-based tools for software developers. Adapt popular developer web services to run in the high-side environment, meet customer security requirements, interoperate with each other, and present a uniform appearance. Learn new web stacks on the fly in support of such modifications. Write Chef cookbooks to support the automated deployment of services and unit tests to support the continuous integration process. Mentor other engineers in software architectures and development practices.

• Extended an open-source Python shell library (Sultan) to accept and output streaming I/O in a non-blocking fashion. Previously, it would accept a command, run it, and dump all the output upon completion; leaving users in the dark while it ran, and even after, if there was a Python exception.
• Updated, improved, and expanded the team orientation materials during my own indoctrination to the project, streamlining the path for engineers who came after.
• Reverse-engineered the Eclipse Marketplace service in order to scrape Eclipse plugins and serve them directly to the Eclipse IDE on the high side.
• Helped the customer to determine that developing and maintaining our web-based linter service was an ineffective use of resources by proposing a set of experiments to determine what value the user base derived from it.
• Sped up virus scanning by a factor of 8 for all software repository mirroring jobs by running a virus-scanning daemon and having the ingest pipeline submit files to it through a socket, rather than calling a virus scanner executable on each package.
• Created a regex pattern-based filename parser that reliably identifies and categorizes messy and unpredictable python package name formats.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer - Chimera
experience.description:
Implement the next generation of Chimera, a leading-edge analytic platform that merges the discovery and tracking powers of TAC (described below) with link analysis and entity resolution capabilities, on an AWS microservice architecture. Pioneer the integration of useful new platforms, frameworks, and libraries, leaving clear examples for those who follow. Create powerful new capabilities by integrating existing capabilities with elegant Ruby modules and RESTful APIs. Guide engineers through tricky implementation issues. Identify ways to meet established functionality goals in the face of significant staff and funding reductions.

• Architected and implemented a Spark-, Kafka-, and S3-based real­-time, regular-expression, persistent-queried search engine to replace the back-end of Boeing's TAC application.
• Devised performance tests for my own microservices that revealed previously-unknown limitations in connecting microservices, then took the lead in troubleshooting those, ultimately increasing system throughput 100-fold.
• Built a horizontally-scalable, filesystem-like (unique hierarchical paths) storage and retrieval service on top of a Google Drive-style (non-unique paths) cloud storage service, using Zookeeper InterProcessReadWriteLocks to enforce coordination between REST calls and path cache updates on separate nodes.
• Devised and executed an unused query cleanup procedure at the behest of project management, after they were told by the main development organization that it “couldn’t be done”. Ultimately reduced DFA state complexity by 80%, thus speeding up persistent search execution five­fold.
• To meet an urgent client priority, developed a Ruby library to parse GeoJSON and identify geo-coordinates within any country in the world, in about an hour.

experience.title: Lead Engineer, Cross­-Domain Solutions
experience.description:
Work hand-in-glove with PM staff to ensure that client expectations are met and development remains in sync with shifting requirements and situational realities. Craft requirements based on client expectations, agency rules, and engineering needs. Establish priorities and deliverables over the course of the development cycle. Collaborate with developers; supporting software engineering ideals, adherence to requirements, and team morale. Achieve certification of new versions while building relationships with key stakeholders to the process. Plan and execute seamless transitions between versions.

• Assumed engineering leadership of a failing project upon the unanticipated departure of the previous lead, and successfully deployed the unfinished next version within a client-negotiated timeline.
• Built multi-regional and multi-generational development and support teams from scratch, training and assigning roles to engineers with no prior CDS knowledge or background.
• Improved client confidence in Boeing, leading to a multi-million dollar expansion of the contract.
• Shortened and parallelized the file-scanning workflow, increasing per-node throughput more than 200-fold.
• Architected a universal, simplified system pipeline to replace many complex per-client pipelines; simplifying system configuration, maintenance, and future engineering.
• Built a version-controlled software repository and an automated system kickstart to replace a lengthy, haphazard process in which each instance of each piece of software used by the system was manually installed, modified and configured.
• Created a modular, scalable and redundant architecture.
• Developed a usage and performance metrics reporting system that scales automatically with the system and assembles coherent, system-wide reports on the high side.
• Implemented a testing/monitoring system which can scale any incoming data feed by percentage, byte count or item count; and tracks items through every step in the pipeline.

experience.title: Principal Engineer; Reporting, Analysis and Forensics
experience.description:
Tackle the highest-impact, most complex and most resilient technical challenges facing TAC; a real-time, persistent-queried, all-source analytic capability. Support all architectural levels and engineering disciplines. Profile system usage and performance. Help test and performance teams reproduce production conditions in test environments. Provide reliable scalability projections in support of future development. Mentor junior engineers. Develop SOPs for system administrators and automate frequent and elaborate tasks. Participate in system architecture design. Clearly and accurately explain business-critical technical concepts to people of non-technical backgrounds.

• Prototyped a comprehensive usage metrics reporting system, giving senior management "a baseline understanding of where customers seek and find value in TAC and TAC data". The follow-on product enables personnel to "monitor and apply these metrics for internal business and process improvements, as well as to improve customer support and outreach".
• Discovered, researched and explained an impending explosive growth in event data and its implications for the sustainability of future operations. This led directly to the organization of a new development team around the problem, and the re-architecting of core search and dissemination infrastructure.
• Engineered the consolidation of our two largest (and oldest) deployments, addressing requirements including scalability; user experience; configuration, database, and message traffic merges; and administrative and user support actions.
• Designed and implemented real-time reporting showing how changes to the query set would impact system performance, restoring the failed confidence of our operations staff.
• Identified a hardware design flaw that stopped production; worked with representatives from Red Hat and Hewlett-Packard to develop effective preventative measures.
• Led the reduction of a critical system failover procedure from 1.5 days to 15 minutes.
experience.position: Principal Engineer; Reporting, Analysis and Forensics

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description:
Support the baseline system in a government contract. Contribute to full life cycle software development in a CMMI Level 5 organization. Work with leads to establish requirements, implement new features, fix reported problems, devise and execute verification procedures.

• Implemented a key portion of a new baseline product.
• Identified a proposed messaging change that would have provided minimal benefit and cost weeks of product team time, and led team leads to cancel it.
• Tracked down a problematic Y2K fix in COTS software and devised a workaround that has been officially adopted.
